page.layout: One page of text, single column of litany lines with braces at right and left-hand brace annotations ("Libera nos Domine", "Libera nos Domine", "Te rogamus, Audi nos") in the right margin; running head at top; signature/catchword "K 3" and "Agne" at foot.

main_text.p: Omnes Sanctæ virgines & viduæ, Orate pro nobis.
main_text.head: PER NATIVITATEM, RESURRECTIONEM & Ascensionem tuam.
main_text.p: Per adventum Spiritus S. paracleti,Libera nos Domine.
Ut remissionem peccatorum nostrorum nobis dones
Ut Ecclesiam tuam regere & conservare digneris,
Ut Dominum Apostolicum, & omnes gradus Ecclesiasticos in Sancta religione conservare digneris,Te rogamus, Audi nos.
Ut fructus terræ nobis dare & conservare digneris,

page.notes: Brace annotations in the margins read "Libera nos Domine" (twice) and "Te rogamus, Audi nos"; marginal brace marks are not transcribed as text. Some letters in the scan are damaged; readings follow the clearest forms.
